description: Start the CDC to lakehouse stack once before the step specs run (beforeAny in .doc-detective.json). The Iceberg topic, the schema, the change data capture pipelines, and the row changes are all created by the step specs themselves, in step order, so nothing is pre-seeded here. Never selected as a step spec. The timeout covers the first run, which pulls Postgres, MySQL, MinIO, Spark, Redpanda, and Console and builds the Spark image.
